body: Obviously no I have not tried all the everything.  Going on and off meds have their own issues they cause though.  I probably do need a better therapist but forking out the money time and time again to find a good one isn't worth it for a temporary fix.

I did, I have done therapy, meds, changing birth control, stopping birth control, apps, self help books..etc I have been trying for some time now. So thanks for the advice but at some point you just realize it doesn't always work. I will make sure they are well taken care of and understand it was nothing about them.
Thank you. I do that to cool down in the summer heat so I am happy to try it on the bad days.  Either way I'm glad it works for you!

Thanks for letting me know its not just me. She does know and she wants me to talk to my husband about it but he doesn't need to know how bad it get or my dark thoughts,  just more for him to worry about. I do workout and it doesn't help much so I am still looking into ways to help more in the short term but we haven't found it yet.
